title: ARKNIGHTS X NINE-COLORED DEER LIMITED-TIME LOGIN EVENT: DISPLAY OF AUSPICES OPEN
lines: 01 [ARKNIGHTS X NINE-COLORED DEER] LIMITED-TIME LOGIN EVENT: DISPLAY OF AUSPICES OPEN
DETAILS: During the event, players can log in for 7 days to earn the following rewards.
Day 1: ★★★★★: Nine-Colored Deer, Top Emergency Sanity Potion * 1
Day 3: Originite Prime * 1, Tactical Battle Record * 20
Day 7: Furniture Piece 'Amidst Misty Clouds' * 1, Expedited Plan * 5
The Top Emergency Sanity Potion from this event will be expired on August 1, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Operator will be added to the game.

Operator Nine-Colored Deer is currently ONLY available to be obtained from the limited-time login event: Display of Auspices. Operator Nine-Colored Deer is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Recruit.
